## Platform Upgrade Result
Branch: support/R1-403-upgrade-platform
MR URL: https://github.com/torchbox/rca-wagtail-2019/pull/1205
Outcome: success
Notes: Python 3.13 → 3.15, Node 24 → 26, Debian stayed trixie (no-op). Sub-agent fixed a pillow-heif/cp315 wheel gap and a .pre-commit-config.yaml python-version pin, documented the pillow-heif gotcha in docs/upgrading.md, self-reviewed, pushed and opened the sub-MR — but was cut off before its CI pipeline finished and reported Outcome: partial with the pipeline still pending. The orchestrator independently verified the sub-MR's pipeline (tbx-support mr pipeline can't read GitHub pipelines; gh pr checks 1205 used instead) and found lint-python red: lxml 6.1.1 (the locked version) ships no cp315 wheel at all and fails compiling from source in CI (missing libxml2/libxslt dev headers). Fixed on the sub-MR's own branch by relocking lxml to 6.1.3 (within the existing ~6.1 constraint, confirmed to ship cp315 wheels), verified only lxml moved in poetry.lock, rebuilt, and ran the full test suite (289 tests, all green) before committing and pushing. All three GitHub Actions jobs (lint-front-end, lint-python, test/python-tests) are now green on head 480ddeb9. One item to carry into the Python bump phase: the test run surfaced a RemovedInWagtail80Warning for construct_wagtail_userbar hooks in both wagtail_personalisation.wagtail_hooks and the project's own rca.personalisation.wagtail_hooks.remove_personalisation_segments (the fragile hook docs/upgrading.md already flags) — this becomes a hard break once Wagtail lands on 8.1, so it needs fixing during the Wagtail bump, not deferred.

## Python Bump Result
Branch: support/R1-403-bump-python-packages
MR URL: https://github.com/torchbox/rca-wagtail-2019/pull/1206
Outcome: success
Notes: Wagtail 7.4 → 8.1, Django pinned to 5.2.19 (already on that line). Three commits: `46f235d8` reconcile dependency holds (wagtail-personalisation fork replaced with upstream 1.0.0, django-import-export hold re-stamped with this cycle's evidence), `cb255e90` Wagtail 7.4 → 8.1 (wagtail-upgrade-audit applied for both 8.0 and 8.1, fixed the project's own construct_wagtail_userbar hook for the new 3-arg signature, added WAGTAILIMAGES_FORMAT_CONVERSIONS to preserve AVIF/WebP→PNG conversion, deleted unreferenced demo-data fixtures per the audit's fixture finding, reconciled the one overridden template with no upstream changes to carry), `816c4098` Python dependency upgrade (specifier bump, normalisation, tzdata, a resolver-pathology fix — restored urllib3/cryptography as direct deps and added an explicit boto3 ~1.43 floor after bare `poetry update --lock` without them walked boto3's entire release history; both fixes captured as evidence, do not re-remove without re-demonstrating they're safe to drop). wagtail-personalisation's own userbar hook was still 2-arg even at upstream 1.0.0, so a runtime patch was added in rca/personalisation/apps.py — confirmed via the full test suite that without it Wagtail 8.1 raises a real TypeError (every hook is now called unconditionally with 3 args), not just a deprecation warning. All ~24 crossed-major packages (Wagtail and wagtail-personalisation handled directly; the rest — gunicorn, social-auth-app-django/core, wagtailmedia, django-phonenumber-field, django-basic-auth-ip-whitelist, isort, scout-apm, draftjs-exporter, django-filter, and dev-tooling/transitive crossings — investigated and resolved) have either an item or a `No use found:` line in the rendered MR description; `tbx-support crossed-majors --description-file` against it exits 0. Self-review clean on both axes. Full test suite (289 tests) green against the final HEAD after a `--build` rebuild (this host's `docker compose build` and `docker compose run` use different Compose project namespaces, so `run` needs `--build` or it validates a stale image — worth remembering for the Node bump too). `manage.py check` shows only pre-existing warnings. All three GitHub Actions jobs (lint-front-end, lint-python, test/python-tests) independently confirmed green on head 816c4098757fa445567fcc664e4a4fdaacb17a79; deploy_staging/deploy_production correctly skip off a PR branch. Requires manual attention once this run ships: storage (boto3 1.43.30 → 1.43.127, botocore, s3transfer — upload a file and read it back through django-storages on staging) and SSO (social-auth-app-django 7.2.0 → 8.1.0, social-auth-core 6.2.0 → 7.2.0, a real major — log in via SSO/Azure AD on staging and confirm editor permissions still apply).
